source_caption_text:
Rell Vert made an unreleased tribute song for BloodHound Q50, called “Letter To 50” 🕊️

Vert reportedly wasn’t able to attend Q50’s funeral for safety reasons just a few days ago 👀💔

Rell Vert and BloodHound Q50 (Mikquale T. A. Cooper) are American rappers from Chicago, Illinois, known for their prominent roles in the city’s drill music scene. They initially shared a close relationship as frequent musical collaborators and associates within the “Bloodhound” collective, releasing multiple joint tracks together such as “Bleed Red,” “Trending Topic,” and “Lunch Break Freestyle”. While they built their early careers together, their relationship reportedly became strained over time, and rumors of a feud or “beef” circulated online in the months leading up to BloodHound Q50’s death in September 2026.
